How many around the table?

Lay the panel flat. Everyone gets their own edge, with their own five files facing them. You can change this at any time from the puck in the middle.

Two per long side, one at each end. Any card can be moved by anyone, and a flick sends it sliding across the table. To file a card, hold it over the tray until the tray fills.
